summary: Frontend-only regression on Zayado covering the 5 P0/P1 flows: shared vision board editing by guest (polezayado), owner cross-check (test.pro), news 'Enregistrer' button, news card auto-summary, bell stability across navigation, actu rythme onboarding for test.solo, and non-regression for test.pro. All 7 scenarios passed.

issues: Console: React DOM nesting warning — <button> nested inside <button> in DropdownMenu wrapping data-testid=header-mail. Not blocking but produces hydration warning.

action_items: (Optional) Fix DOM nesting warning: DropdownMenuTrigger asChild + inner <button> results in <button> descendant of <button> around header-mail. Use a <span>/<div> as inner trigger or remove asChild.
critical_code_review_comments: VisionCanvas.jsx is ~2200 lines — consider splitting into card renderers, tools rail, and topbar for maintainability.
Header.jsx nests <button> inside DropdownMenuTrigger asChild, generating hydration warnings on every page load.
test_credentials: polezayado@gmail.com / Zyd2026SecureJWTkey! (guest editor), test.pro@zayado.net / Test!2026 (board owner), test.solo@zayado.net / Test!2026 (no actu_rythme set — reset to quotidien after test).
seed_data_creation: Added one card text 'MODIF_TEST_1790689815' on the first card of the shared 'marketing-communication' board (persisted). Rythme actu for test.solo was set to 'lundi' during test then reset to 'quotidien' at end (clean).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 fixes work end-to-end in the UI. Verified selectors: vision-partages-moi, vision-board-partage-marketing-communication, vision-partage-badge (visible), vision-board-switcher (correctly hidden in shared mode), vision-save-status (title='Enregistré' after edit, no error toast), actu-save-0 (toast + actu-enregistres appears), actu-item-1 (auto-sends prompt, chat-msg-user + chat-msg-assistant appear without pressing send), bell-badge stays at '2' on /app and /actions (hidden on /app/vision because vision has its own header — this is by design, not blinking), actu-rythme-question + actu-rythme-lundi visible for test.solo and save is confirmed in /parametres → Notifications (parametres-actu-rythme select). Non-regression: test.pro shows 'Bonjour, Pro' cockpit and does NOT show actu-rythme-question. Minor: DOM nesting warning around header-mail dropdown trigger (button inside button).
